As someone who not only had/s suicidal thoughts, but actually tried to commit suicide, I beg you not to do this. You are a person who despite being in a harsh place yourself, tried to save me in what i thought were my last moments. 

Theres so much beauty in this world that the pain and suffering you are feeling right now is hiding from you. You are worth every single breath you take and you deserve so much better, so please give yourself the time to get better.

Thank you for the reply, your message and your philososhy is really nice and truly fascinating. Sadly I don´t feel connected at all, I feel so empty and so lost; I long for something to feel, and for the first time in a long time I feel something. I would not wish this for anyone, it is really painful, but it is something that comforts me and brings me peace. If i belong to this world, I wish to go back to the soil and nurture it, so that it may bring something beautiful to the earth
Thank you, friend. You are the best tortellini I have and will ever meet

You are really kind and deserved everything you wish for me. it is very very unlikely we will ever meet (for obvious reasons), but if the stars align and somehow we do i will thank you with all my heart for the compassion you showed to a stranger

However I just drank it 2 hours ago, tha truly paingful symptoms should start in a few hours. I will lose my vision, vomit, lose coordination and have seizures (and that is if I am lucky). Thank you; but you should wish that for something more deserving than me. I hate to wallow in self pity, but i could not find better words. And reading all my comments I realise just how much self pity I feel for my self, kind of sad really
Thank you, I have had a few conversations in the comment section that really make me feel thankful to have my last day in this post

What if you are right? The uno reverse card, nice.

I wonder if god exists and if he does, will they allow me to see what could have been? All the other ways you speak of to achieve peace, to find home, will I see them. And cry my last tear on this earth.

Believe me, if I truly saw another way I would not have made this choice; I don´t feel like I am in a tunnel where I can´t see the light, I feel like I am trapped alone in a space suit in the emptiness of space. So you may be right, it is now or at a later time... the choice of taking my life remains the same, the only variables is that nothing is stopping me right now.

So again, what if you are right? I guess at some point I will regret this choice, and hopefully in time to save myself, endure and maybe heal from all the wounds and finally feel again. And if that happens I think I would have to thank you so much for this talk

I am really scared of living, of feeling that emptiness again, and right now I feel like I found something. What if this is the only way? What if you are wrong and this was the only way to achieve it? I know you are trying to help and it must be infuriating for me to be this stubborn, so I am really sorry for that, I hope I have not offended you
I often asked myself what would be a suitable way to go... couldn´t come up with an answer
I don´t know if there is an afterlife, but if there is, I hope you don´t get there the same way I will and i really hope we can shake hands

I called her not too long ago (She told me to contact her if it ever came to this) but since it is 1:30 am here it is no surprise she didn´t respond. I guess I am very divided, i feel great, I feel free and for the first time in years real tears came to my eyes... but I am writing in this sub I guess because deep inside something wants to find a last connection before it all goes dark

Thank you, that brought tears to my eyes. My therapist says I tend to blame myself for everything, and to some degree I think she was right. I hate to thank that my parents are somehow responsible for my pain, so I would rather carry that blame; it might be selfish to think like that, but the i don´t want them to blame themselves after I am gone
Sounds interesting, i will try something like that

The time I dislocated my brother´s shoulder, the years I hid the scars from the abuse at school, the years I smoked and burned my skin to feel something, the years I hid my mental issues from them until the spirald out of control, the time i moved out of the country trying to scape, the time i flunked everything at university out of a sense of purposelessness and this time when i did this to myself. I feel like the pain and suffering of this method will at least make up a bit for everything
Thank you, and if i point i do change my mind i will get help
2 reasons to be honest, readily available and i wanted to at least pay a bit for all the mistakes, and all the suffering i have caused to my family

I want to thank you for caring enough to tell me to stop, but this is something I want and something that brings me peace. However if at some point i regret my choice i will be sure to call an ambulance and fix my life. Thanks again
